metadata.description: The PHPFixes plugin for Claude Code: a read-only PHP2Shell check for PHP packages and the workers actually running.

plugins.name: phpfixes
plugins.description: Check whether PHP is fixed for PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) from evidence you supply: php -v, package versions and the PHP-FPM or Apache workers actually running. Handles Ubuntu and Debian backports. Read-only; it never connects to your server.
